stories.title: Health board wants alcohol harm considered before Flintshire pubs and shops get licences
stories.summary: North Wales’s health board wants Flintshire County Council to take an area’s deprivation and alcohol harm into account before licensing pubs, clubs and shops to sell alcohol. stories.title: ‘One big family’: Flintshire foster carers on the scheme no other Welsh council offers
stories.summary: Flintshire remains the only council in Wales running the Mockingbird fostering scheme, six years after introducing it, Foster Wales Flintshire said. stories.title: Stanlow refinery broke permit conditions 58 times in two years, Environment Agency finds
stories.summary: Natural England dropped an investigation into an oil spill from Stanlow refinery after deciding the site’s permit set no limit on oil released, the BBC said, citing internal emails. stories.title: Mynydd Isa Scout leader to lead school repair team in Malawi over Christmas
stories.summary: A Scout leader from Mynydd Isa will spend Christmas and New Year in Malawi leading a team repairing a primary school damaged by a tropical cyclone. Lily, a leader with Mynydd Isa Scouts, has been selected to join a group of 10 Scouts from across the UK and is the only one travelling from Wales.
